items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I saw Catherine when she did Aida in Knocke... She did not know how to ride a bicycle so she and another woman friend of hers rented a four wheeled pedal contraption and rode to Sluis or Seebrugge with us.

ctx.x: Benny Carter had a vacation from his job in the B.B.C. so he and his wife Inez came to Knocke, but Benny was on holiday and never sat in with the band although he came to the club often. Another famous

Negro woman who was an opera singer and had sang in the casino was Miss Catherine Yarbo. I saw Catherine when she did Aida in Knocke and she was a great artist. She had her vacation after playing the casino and stayed in Knocke for two weeks. She did not know how to ride a bicycle so she and another woman friend of hers rented a four wheeled pedal contraption and rode to Sluis or Seebrugge with us.
We finished at the Pingoin the last of August and Willie had a two week engagement in Den Hague at a dance hall called the "Tabarin".
